signals.original_title: ‘Our new normal’: how marine heatwaves affect life in British seas
signals.quote: The impact of repeated heatwaves on fisheries may take a couple of years to become apparent because, even if adults survived the elevated temperatures, eggs and juveniles may have been affected. And experts do not know if the cold-water fishes that moved north will return after the heatwaves end.
